title: React JS Mini Project
outcome: You will use concepts like components, state and props, routing, conditional rendering, JSX and build a fully functional React JS application by the end of this course
why: Including a mini project on your resume or portfolio can help you stand out from other candidates and show potential employers that you have hands-on experience with React JS. It can also be a good way to demonstrate your problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

resources.title: Mini-Project Completion Checklist
resources.content: ## **1. Mini-Project Walkthrough** Go through the `Mini-Projects Walkthrough session` to get a better understanding of the Mini-Projects. ## **2. Mini-Project Completion Checklist** Kindly follow the below Checklist for Mini-Project Completion - At least 90% of the test cases of the Mini-Project should be completed. - Achieve both desktop and mobile UI as per the given Figma URLs. - You have to **submit** the project to know the percentage of completion through test cases. - Use the below command to submit the project ~~~Python ccbp submit PROJECT_ID ~~~ - Also, it's important to **publish** the project frequently. - Use the below command to publish the project ~~~Python ccbp publish PROJECT_ID domain_name.ccbp.tech ~~~ - **Note:** - In the above two commands use your respective **Project id** in place of **PROJECT_ID.** - Use your own **Domain name** (Example: rahul.ccbp.tech) in place of **domain_name.ccbp.tech.** ## **3.** **Mini-Project Video Submission** - Make a 5 - 10 minute video explaining your code and the features that you have implemented in your Mini Project. - Upload your recorded video to your YouTube account and submit the video link in this [form](https://forms.ccbp.in/react-mini-project-submission). - Refer to this video to get a better understanding of uploading videos to your YouTube account. - Video should contain - Component Hierarchy by showing your code - Your explanation by using the published link should contain the below points - Components you have used for each route. - Third-party libraries that you have used in each route if any. - Responsiveness of your application in (Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop) by using developer Tools. - **Note :** - You should speak and explain the code in the recorded video. - Use Updated Chrome version for your Video recording.
